correctness.rationale: PASS — Reconstructed the expectation from independent Bernoulli pollinator failures: protected j removes each adjacent plant extinction event q^{d_i}, hence gain G_j(q)=sum_{i:j in N(i)}q^{d_i} and H_j=G_j/q. Pairwise difference of normalized gains is a signed sum with at most four monomials when there are <=4 plants. Constant-sign cases are trivial; if one sign is a singleton, compare its least exponent and the strictly monotone sum after division; if two terms of each sign, either Descartes plus the forced q=1 root leaves <=1 interior zero, or alternating ordered exponents split into two same-signed differences. Thus no strict +,-,+ between any two options. The constructed five neighborhoods {A}, {B,F1}, {B,F2}, {A,F1,F2,F3,F4,F5} twice yield H_A=1+2q^5, H_B=2q and every other target strictly below A on (0,1). f=1-2q+2q^5 has f(0)=f(1)=1 and f(3/4)=-13/512, with derivative -2+10q^4 increasing through one root, proving exactly two switches. Independent 2^7-state exact rational survival enumeration for q=1/4,3/4,9/10 gave unique winners A,B,A and matching gain formula for all seven targets. The universal <=4 bound comes from the proof, not enumeration.
